description: The Shotgun end to end through real input: the shop still refuses one because the catalogue entry stays invisible until the owner's feel gate, the lab tool key draws a loaded five-shell magazine, pointer travel aims it, one primary press releases six pellets that share a single interaction identity and hurt the buddy, the R action reloads a partial magazine, an emptied magazine dry-fires into the two-second automatic reload, and selecting Grab puts the gun away.
